## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 100% | 100% (estimate, medium confidence, 98.4–100%) | not applicable | 0% |

armenia-law (public, pinned 8aaa548 = main) holds the 2015 Constitution with its 2020 amendment and every essential code as consolidated ARLIS texts with dated in-force history to 2026-10-24, and both spot checks of the Constitution match ARLIS. But 38 laws ARLIS marks repealed still have full text on main (among them the 1961 Criminal Code, the 1961 Criminal Procedure Code and the 1964 Civil Procedure Code), the new Bankruptcy Code is shown in force from 2026-09-01 although it takes effect one year after publication (about 2027-07-03), four changes in force 2026-11-01 sit only on 'future', no case law is held, and a 13,162-act sub-law build sits unlinked on wip branches of armenia-sublaws.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
